why_this_route.supersedes: v7 keeps the spec-authorized v2 plurigaussian route but upgrades ground-level QUALITY (v6 read under-detailed at a 6 cm eye view) and adds the #104 pool-depth carve (v6 pools were painted-on flat). It also RESOLVES the v6 known gate-appropriateness followup (fractions/pool_coupling scope).
why_this_route.mechanism: Two stationary Gaussian random fields combined into one latent, ordered-thresholded to guarantee the Moore transiogram ordering, with height a SMOOTH continuous Gaussian anamorphosis of the latent. v7 makes the fine field MULTI-SCALE and the coarse field MULTI-OCTAVE, draws the roughness NATIVELY at 6 cm, and carves the ETAK Laugas bed with a monotone #104 depth wedge.
why_this_route.anti_invention: No FBM as the shipped surface, no marked forms, no reaction-diffusion, no per-class steps, no periodic lattice, no repeated stamps, no decorative noise. The roughness is a deterministic world-keyed high-frequency GRF (additive, NOT in the latent). The pool wedge is the deterministic #104 physics model (ETAK type + measured shore distance), never faked.

site_selection.note: the reselected pool-bearing raised bog with real ETAK Laugas pools; same site and base as the v4/v6 pack.

gate_appropriateness_resolution.resolves: the v6 known_followups_gate_appropriateness (fractions + pool_coupling were measured over the 128 m storage core, smaller than ~2 coarse ridge-hollow wavelengths, so both were fragile to the coarse PHASE the core happened to sample).
gate_appropriateness_resolution.premise_audit_finding: The two gates need OPPOSITE scopes, not the same one. (1) fractions: measure over the WHOLE work-grid authority. Because the latent is standardized over the full authority and the class thresholds ARE its percentiles, the full-authority fractions recover the Ilyasov target by construction and are phase-stable; the tiled-128 m-window distribution proves it (per-window hollow 0.405 +- 0.132 spread vs a stable full-authority 0.402). (2) pool_coupling: KEEP core-scoped (pool-margin coupling is a LOCAL relationship at the real Laugas pools that are actually carved and rendered) but FIX the mis-firing threshold. Measured proof the scope matters: the robust margin-low fraction is 0.759 over the core vs 0.081 over the full 512 m grid, where the pool_bias downshift is ~0-mean against a global datum and most 'open_water' is the distant ditch network, not the Laugas. The brief's suggestion to move BOTH to full-grid was audited and REJECTED on this data for pool_coupling.
gate_appropriateness_resolution.fractions_fix: synth.class_fractions computes class fractions from ndtr(latent_std)[authority] over the WHOLE work grid (not core_slice); run.evaluate reports the tiled-128 m-window mean +- std as phase-stability evidence.
gate_appropriateness_resolution.pool_coupling_fix: gates.pool_coupling: margin-low test is a fixed relief < 0 datum (not the authority median); hummock-over-pool is a fixed relief > +0.06 m band (was height > median+0.06, which counted EVERY relief-free water cell as a hummock once the median skewed hollow). Robust to a hollow skew and to the new non-positive bed wedge.
gate_appropriateness_resolution.safety_gates_unchanged: the core edge-taper and land off-authority (non-water) residual gates stay measured exactly on the core; only the open-water residual gate is REINTERPRETED (below).

quality_upgrades_over_v6.micro_multiscale_fine: fields.multiscale_fine_field: PSD = sqrt(sum_i w_i * Matern(range_i, nu)) over ranges [(0.35,0.6),(0.8,1.0),(1.4,0.12)] (range_m, weight), nu 2.0 -> a ~0.35-1.4 m microform SIZE distribution instead of the v6 single 0.7 m size. One white stream, one field, deterministic. Tuned so the detrended autocorr first-zero stays in [0.3,0.9] m (measured 0.875).
quality_upgrades_over_v6.micro_native_6cm_roughness: the roughness channel is drawn NATIVELY at the 6 cm output pitch (its own world-PRF 'rough' stream keyed on the 6 cm integer world lattice), NOT at 0.25 m then band-limit-interpolated, so it carries genuine sub-0.5 m texture. Additive (height += sigma*rough), NOT in the latent -> cannot disturb ordering/transiogram/fraction gates. sigma raised 0.006 -> 0.018 m (the largest value keeping the anti_artifact PSD slope <= -3.3 with margin; measured -3.53), corner 0.7 m, slope_exp 1.8 (PSD ~ k^-3.6). Latent (fine+coarse) determinism is UNCHANGED (still 0.25 m draw + band-limited interp).
quality_upgrades_over_v6.macro_multioctave_coarse: fields.multiscale_coarse_field: PSD superposes anisotropic Gaussian octaves (major_len,minor_len,weight) = [(90,34,1.0),(55,20,0.7),(32,12,0.45)], every major axis perpendicular to flow, re-standardized to unit variance -> a RANGE of ridge spacings, breaking the v6 single 60/22 m wavelength stripe spectrum (periodicity peak 1.46, coarse half-autocorr 22.75 m >= 8). Domain-warp escalation was NOT needed and NOT applied (avoid over-engineering).

pool_depth_carve.task: #104 pool-depth carve (case B, surface-independent): the rendered water surface Y comes from a SEPARATE `water` HeightLevel plane (waterY), NOT the `height` layer. The bog preview corrects only HEIGHT, so it INHERITS the base's water plane UNCHANGED; carving the bed DOWN opens a real water column (Beer-Lambert).
pool_depth_carve.implementation: synth._pool_bed_depth computes the deterministic depth wedge via process.water.bed_depth_field over the SAME haloed work window at 6 cm (so a Laugas is measured against its whole polygon shore, not clipped at the core edge; coverage supersample disabled for the call to keep the 8192^2 window in memory, coverage discarded). relief_work[open_water] = -depth * core_edge_taper (mirrors layers_cook h - depth; the core-edge taper keeps a pool clipped at the storage-core boundary from stepping into the uncarved baseline). Per-type depth from ETAK E_202 tyyp (Laugas plateau 1.5 m over a 10 m shore shelf d = dmax*(2s - s^2)).

measured_carve_in_frozen_core.note: positive metres carved BELOW the inherited water surface; max 1.47 m ~ the Laugas 1.5 m plateau. waterY is UNTOUCHED (the height-only packer never writes a water layer).

reinterpreted_open_water_safety_gate.new: open water carries NO positive/microform relief; it carries ONLY a monotone, non-positive Laugas bed wedge (0 >= relief >= -dmax, 0 at shore, deepening inward). waterY untouched. This forbids FAKE bumps in water while permitting the legitimate #104 monotone depth carve DOWN the user asked for.
reinterpreted_open_water_safety_gate.synth_gate: run.evaluate safety: land_off_authority_residual_cells == 0 AND water_positive_relief_cells == 0 AND core_edge_abs_p99 <= 0.01; reports water_relief min/mean/max.
reinterpreted_open_water_safety_gate.verifier_gate: network_preview_verify hardMasks now ASSERTS openWaterPositiveReliefCells == 0 on the frozen float's open_water_core (not a static label); reports openWaterBedWedgeMinReliefM.
